name: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Write a complete Qiskit program demonstrating
task_prompt: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Write a complete Qiskit program demonstrating the effect of depolarizing noise (p1=0.0067, p2=0.0484) on a GHZ state using AerSimulator and a custom NoiseModel. The code must be a complete standalone script that can be executed directly and produces output.
